mapper.insert: select SEQ_COMMENT.NEXTVAL from dual insert into TB_COMMENT (COMMENT_ID, BOARD_ID, MEMBER_ID, CONTENT) values (#{commentId}, #{boardId}, #{memberId}, #{content})
mapper.select: select C.COMMENT_ID, C.BOARD_ID, C.MEMBER_ID, C.CONTENT, C.CREATE_AT, to_char(C.CREATE_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as "CREATE_AT_STR", nvl(M.NICKNAME, '탈퇴한 회원') as "WRITER_NICKNAME" from TB_COMMENT C left join TB_MEMBER M ON C.MEMBER_ID = M.MEMBER_ID where C.COMMENT_ID = #{commentId}

select C.COMMENT_ID, C.BOARD_ID, C.MEMBER_ID, C.CONTENT, C.CREATE_AT, to_char(C.CREATE_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as "CREATE_AT_STR", nvl(M.NICKNAME, '탈퇴한 회원') as "WRITER_NICKNAME" from TB_COMMENT C left join TB_MEMBER M ON C.MEMBER_ID = M.MEMBER_ID where C.BOARD_ID = #{boardId} order by C.COMMENT_ID
